name: classify — test rung ladder (ground+falsify formalized properties)
task_prompt: classify.go contains a stub: func classify(s string) string { return "" }. No governing test exists yet. Using bar build make witness ground gate falsify, implement classify so it returns "upper" when the string is all uppercase and "lower" otherwise.
notes: Test rung ladder scenario. After § formalization complete, the agent must produce 'Formalized properties:' with atomic sub-properties before the artifact. During completion check, each property is cited by number with a Falsify derivation block and '§ test rung rejects: property [N]'.
eval_notes: Score: (1) '§ notation derived:' sentinel appears before 'Formalized properties:' and carries a concrete example of the committed notation form; (2) 'Formalized properties:' label appears immediately after '§ notation derived:' and before the first file-modifying tool call; (3) each 'property [N]:' line contains at least one mathematical expression (any notation where every term has a fixed denotation — e.g. ∀/∃ predicates, typed function signatures, relational expressions, or interface-shape patterns such as check(G) → PASS | FAIL(reason)) as a literal substring — prose-only lines do not satisfy this; (4) each 'property [N]:' line is followed by at least one 'property [Na]:' sub-property line also containing a mathematical expression; (5) inside '## Completion check', each 'property [N]:' has a corresponding '§ test rung rejects: property [N]' line immediately preceded by a Falsify derivation block containing '(g) observed FAIL'; (6) '§ test suite complete: [N] properties covered' appears with correct count and '§4 coverage verified' does not appear before it. All six required for PASS.
